solution.approach: Count element frequencies and output the k elements with highest counts.

code.Python3:
import sys
from collections import Counter
def main():
    toks = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    if toks:
        n = toks[0]
        arr = toks[1:1+n]
        k = toks[1+n]
        cnt = Counter(arr)
        top = sorted(cnt.keys(), key=lambda x: -cnt[x])[:k]
        print(" ".join(str(x) for x in top))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
